judged_text: The migration calls execute(...)[0]['id'] on a query whose result set is empty on any install where the embed_category site setting has never been set (all fresh installs), crashing the migration with NoMethodError on nil. db:migrate fails for every new install (no 'embed_category' row exists, so the INNER JOIN returns zero rows and [0] is nil), blocking deployment entirely; the `if category_id == 0` fallback is unreachable because the code crashes before reaching it.
